name: Poor Bird
storyline: Poor Bird follows a small bird's journey across ten increasingly hostile environments — from a peaceful sunny park through a tropical beach, an ancient desert, a haunted Halloween night, a frozen winter landscape, a greedy modern city, a blooming spring field, a neon-lit cyberpunk district, a volcanic underworld, and finally an armed military battlefield. At the end of each stage, the bird must survive a confrontation with that environment's guardian boss & going through monster waves and back & forth hazards systems before advancing to the next.
summary: Poor Bird is a 2D side-scrolling arcade survival game inspired by Flappy Bird. Across 10 themed levels, players navigate obstacles and dynamic hazards before facing a boss encounter at the end of each stage. The game features a two-phase level structure alternating between low-hazard "leisure" zones and high-hazard "danger" zones, a monster wave system introduced in the later levels, and a set of general and level-specific cheat codes. The game supports offline play and includes optional in-app purchases to remove ads.
